# Enclave Compute

> Practical AI consulting, workflow automation, and team training for small businesses in the Research Triangle.

## About

Enclave Compute is a Garner-based AI enablement consultancy serving the Research Triangle. We help small businesses identify useful AI opportunities, implement one bounded workflow at a time, and train staff to operate and improve it.

We begin with a fixed-fee AI Readiness Assessment that maps the current process, identifies a measurable opportunity, documents data and human-review boundaries, and recommends the simplest suitable approach. A bounded first workflow can often be targeted for launch within two weeks after requirements, access, and approvals are ready.

## Key facts

- Backed by product and engineering experience spanning payments, enterprise security, healthcare data platforms, cloud systems, workflow automation, and applied AI
- Service area: Raleigh, Durham, Chapel Hill, Cary, Garner, and the wider Research Triangle, NC
- Works with managed business AI, workflow automation, integrations, and fit-dependent infrastructure
- Designs workflows around approved inputs, visible human checkpoints, measurable outcomes, and staff adoption
- Recommends private infrastructure only when the workflow's sensitivity or operating requirements justify it
- Current technical proof-of-work uses controlled prototypes and synthetic inputs, not claims of completed client deployments

## Who we work with

- Healthcare: dental, orthodontic, and medical practices
- Legal: solo practitioners and small firms
- Professional services: accounting, consulting, and advisory teams

## Core services

- Opportunity Mapping — identify a measurable first use case
- Workflow Implementation — configure the tools and operating process
- Automation & Integrations — connect approved information and business systems with human review
- Team Training & Adoption — teach staff to operate, evaluate, and improve the workflow
